title: Railway Asset Management

canonicalTerminology.definition: Asset management is coordinated activity through which an organisation realises value from assets over their lifecycle.

claims.text: Railway asset decisions balance performance, risk, cost and lifecycle objectives while preserving applicable safety and regulatory obligations.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.

visualSpecs.purpose: Show lifecycle decision loop for railway assets.
